data.body:
[P2] Roll back hold intents when the pre-dispatch save fails

If this save raises, `put_object()` has not run, but the hold remains `PENDING` in `control_records` and absent from `self.gates`. Consequently, `release_all()` skips it and `delete_controls()` rejects the unresolved hold. A transient local write failure before any invocation therefore prevents retirement and retains the persistent target fence, blocking subsequent runs. Roll back the definitively undispatched intent and reconcile any persisted receipt. Add a regression that fails this save once and verifies no S3/Invoke dispatch and successful no-work retirement.
